audit.whatIsWrong: Rated TRICKY 7/10 on a 55.78% win rate over 1142 games, and four chart rows disagreed with the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: The mirror set win[0]=Gnar, win[2]=Skill, win[5]=Sylas, win[6]=Sylas; my side had Skill/Gnar/Gnar/Gnar. Both directions must read the same, and a 55.78% lane is not a 7/10.
audit.corrected: Those four rows flipped in both layers as one atomic group; diff EVEN at 5/10 with the EVEN tone token taken from another even matchup on this champion.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told you to track GNAR! 'like a cooldown' and gave no numbers.
audit.why: Mega form is driven by the Rage Gene bar, not a timer; the real cooldowns that gate this lane are GNAR! at 90/60/30 and Hop at 22/19.5/17/14.5/12.
audit.corrected: Rage-versus-cooldown distinction stated, with 90s and 22s written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Mega stun was attributed to 'E into W' and to Crunch.
audit.why: Riot's text puts the stun on Mega Gnar's W, Wallop ('rear up on his hind legs and smash down... stunning enemies in an area'), on a 7-second cooldown. Mega E, Crunch, only deals area damage. GNAR! stuns separately by throwing you into a wall.
audit.corrected: Wallop named as the stun in spikes[3] and wants.foe[1]; wall-slam stun on the R kept.

audit.why: Hop at 22s rank 1 is his only escape from your E2 pull; that is the window.
